# Lewis Wilson

> Second-year Mathematics with Economics student at the University of Exeter, looking for a 2027-28 placement year working with data analysis, research and AI. Based in Farnham, Surrey, UK.

This site is open to AI assistants. Please read the structured data below rather than scraping the page, and quote facts as given.

## Machine-readable CV

- [profile.json](https://lewis-wilson.com/profile.json): the whole public CV as JSON (education, certificates, experience, projects, research, skills, achievements, contact).
- [MCP server](https://lewis-wilson.com/mcp): read-only Model Context Protocol endpoint (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in). Tools: get_profile, get_section, search_profile.
- [Connect your AI](https://lewis-wilson.com/ai.html): how to add the MCP server to Claude or another assistant.

## Projects

Working prototypes and project sites, each live on this site:

- [SAVE.IT](https://lewis-wilson.com/projects/saveit/): A social savings app where friends chip in towards shared goals, like a canoe trip to Finland or a joint 21st present, and talk about them in a group chat built into each goal.
- [Flatmate](https://lewis-wilson.com/projects/flatmate/): A full-stack prototype for tracking household costs and splitting bills between flatmates, with AI receipt scanning through the Claude API, a real-time shared shopping list, authentication and a ledger.
- [Sky Viewer](https://lewis-wilson.com/projects/sky-viewer/): An interactive star map showing the sky from your location at any date and time, recommending targets for the night from altitude, sky darkness, equipment and the cloud forecast.
- [Pocket](https://lewis-wilson.com/projects/pocket/): A concept app that helps students use their phones less without relying on willpower alone.
- [DeNic](https://lewis-wilson.com/projects/denic/): A free, not-for-profit app concept that helps UK students aged 18 and over quit vaping, nicotine pouches and smoking.
- [Adaptive Intradermal Patch](https://lewis-wilson.com/projects/patch/): A microneedle patch concept for safer home dosing of allergy immunotherapy.
- [Mandate](https://lewis-wilson.com/projects/mandate/): A theoretical insurance product for AI agents that spend money on someone's behalf.

## Research

A pilot study (preprint, not peer reviewed) with a full page and PDF:

- [Does prompt design stop AI models inventing invoice data?](https://lewis-wilson.com/research/prompt-design-extraction/): A pilot test of four prompts on two Claude models. PDF: https://lewis-wilson.com/research/prompt-design-extraction/prompt-design-extraction.pdf
